title: Clinical and radiographic outcomes of a two -piece ceramic implant: one year results from a prospective clinical trial. da
authors: Silva AMP, Horta Dos Santos FA, Mota RF, Teixeira MKS, Telles DM, Lourenço EJV. Clinical and radiographic outcomes of a two-piece ceramic implant: one year results from a prospective clinical trial. Clin Oral Investig. 2024 Jun 18;28(7):380.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss maxresorb / maxresorb inject (biphasic CaP) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The new two-piece ceramic implant used in the present study showed predictable and reliable results, similar to those found with titanium implants after one year of follow -up” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
